name_reason: Follows the data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention: domain=chapter, descriptor fully describes the table (chapter-17 end-scene per-character X position). 'ch17' is a meaningful chapter ID (17 is in the valid chapter range 01-30), not a Ghidra address residue (0x521A3 != 17). '_table' correctly reflects the array/lookup-table data type, and 'pos_x' reflects the content (per-character X tile coordinate). No address residue, name matches use exactly. Keep.
purpose: Read-only per-character X tile-coordinate lookup table for the chapter 17 (Xue Yu Bing Zhi Ren / Blade of Blood and Ice) end scene.
logic_summary: fd2_chapter_17_end (@0x23B77) copies all 16 bytes onto its stack via a MOVSD x4 dword block-copy, then passes the stack block as the pos_x argument to fd2_setup_chars_and_camera_for_intro (@0x233C6). That helper iterates char_idx over the inclusive range [0..0xF] and does prVar1->bPos_x = *(byte *)(char_idx + pos_x_base), i.e. it indexes this table one byte per char (stride 1) and stores each into runtime_char.bPos_x. The companion pos_y_table is adjacent at 0x521B3 (the next MOVSD source in the handler), bounding this table at exactly 16 bytes.
element_semantics: Element [char_idx] = battle-tile X coordinate for runtime character char_idx (0..0xF) during the chapter-17 end cutscene. Values 15..26 (0x0F..0x1A) are tile-grid X coordinates; accessed unsigned, one byte per char, no scaling.
notes: Verified: memory bytes @0x521A3 = 23,22,23,24,21,22,23,24,25,20,21,22,23,24,25,26 match the src table byte-for-byte. xrefs_to show only fd2_chapter_17_end (READ + DATA), no writers -> const confirmed. Consumer fd2_setup_chars_and_camera_for_intro confirms stride-1 per-char indexing into runtime_char.bPos_x. Chapter 17 title confirmed via fd2-knowledge: Xue Yu Bing Zhi Ren (Blade of Blood and Ice). src comment (chtab2.c lines 116-131) already precise and accurate -> kept, no Edit made. Ghidra data plate was empty (null) -> created a concise plate consistent with the src conclusion.
